blurb: We're thrilled to present a program featuring multiple award-winning artists - from the world premiere of a new work by composer David Das, to another new work by composer Bikel, performed by Ben Loeb, to Jazzical Komitas by Joel Martin, who reimagines the timeless music of Armenian master Komitas through the language of jazz, creating a bridge between heritage and contemporary expression.
